subject: Make TLS disable/enable INFO checks deterministic for module mode (#3167)
reason: The only behavioral change is in TLS module mode (BUILD_TLS=module): the server's non-OpenSSL tlsResetCertInfo stub no longer wipes the INFO TLS cert serial/expiry fields that the loaded valkey-tls module populated, when a TLS config is set while TLS stays enabled. The fuzzer cannot reach that configuration: connection modules load only at bootup from a build-specific .so the runner does not supply, tls-port is a managed deployment option and a refused CONFIG SET, and no certificate material or TLS module artifact exists in the environment. In the configurations the fuzzer can start the change
